e.title: AWS Audit Manager 保险聊天机器人
e.summary: AWS 技术指南：用 Audit Manager 让 Bedrock 保险聊天机器人对齐负责任 AI 原则
e.body:
AWS 技术指南（HKU SPACE AI Hub 收录）：用 AWS Audit Manager 对齐并监控 Amazon Bedrock 驱动的保险客服聊天机器人与负责任 AI 原则——保险 AI 的合规监控技术路径。对 RIAA：保险 AI 合规监控的技术实操——「Bedrock 聊天机器人 + Audit Manager 审计」的组合（同 [[garak]] 的安全测试、[[langfuse]] 的可观测性、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 的治理标准配套）；理解保险 AI「上线后怎么持续合规」；香港大学的 AI Hub 资源（本地学术源）；保险 AI 治理岗位的技术参考。

e.title_hk: AWS Audit Manager 保險聊天機械人
e.summary_en: AWS technical guide: align/monitor a Bedrock insurance chatbot to responsible-AI principles with AWS Audit Manager
e.summary_hk: AWS 技術指南：用 Audit Manager 讓 Bedrock 保險聊天機械人對齊負責任 AI 原則
e.body_en:
AWS technical guide (curated by the HKU SPACE AI Hub): using AWS Audit Manager to align and monitor an Amazon Bedrock-powered insurance customer-service chatbot with responsible-AI principles — a technical path for insurance-AI compliance monitoring. For RIAA: hands-on compliance monitoring of insurance AI — the Bedrock chatbot + Audit Manager combination (paired with [[garak]] security testing, [[langfuse]] observability and the [[iso-42001-toolkit]] governance standard); understand how insurance AI stays compliant after launch; a HKU AI-Hub resource (local academic source); a technical reference for insurance-AI governance roles.
